                forces[i] += force_mag * diff / dist
        
        step = 0.05 / (1 + iteration * 0.1)
        new_centers = centers + step * forces
        new_centers = np.clip(new_centers, 0.005, 0.995)

def compute_max_radii_lp(centers):
    """Compute max radii using iterative constraint satisfaction."""
    n = len(centers)

    radii = np.array([min(c[0], c[1], 1-c[0], 1-c[1]) for c in centers])
    
    # Pairwise distance matrix
    dists = np.zeros((n, n))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i+1, n):
            d = np.sqrt(np.sum((centers[i] - centers[j])**2))
            dists[i, j] = d
            dists[j, i] = d
    
    # Iteratively enforce pairwise constraints
    for _ in range(50):
        changed = False
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1, n):
                overlap = radii[i] + radii[j] - dists[i, j]
                if overlap > 1e-12:
                    # Shrink proportionally
                    total = radii[i] + radii[j]
                    ratio_i = radii[i] / total
                    ratio_j = radii[j] / total
                    radii[i] -= overlap * ratio_i
                    radii[j] -= overlap * ratio_j
                    changed = True
        if not changed:
            break
    
    radii = np.maximum(radii, 0.0)
    return radii
